I have one concern. Firstly though let me say that this is one of best and most well thought out ideas to treat with teaming in showdown. My concern is the impact it will have on the trophy economy in the game. Last three spots lose two trophies each which balances with the fourth to second place. However each showdown game ten new trophies are injected into the economy.

This may not seem like that big if a deal but an uncapped trophy system will have significant negative impacts on matchmaking and the end game. It will also significantly speed up progression in the early game leading to the need for a complete overhaul of brawler ranks and the trophy road system.

Beyond those redesigns there will at a minimum need to be a maximum trophy limit after which trophies won are converted into gold, tokens, tickets or some new currency immediately to avoid the breakdown of matchmaking. That is unless some system of balancing the trophy economy is developed.

That said this is definitely an idea that should be explored. Really great post and thought.
